environment_details.style_notes: High-fidelity 3D; semi-translucent 'pale' exoskeletons; worker caste is small and rounder; soldier caste has elongated, dark-orange armored heads with sharp mandibles.

visual_logic.composition: A cutaway view of a fallen log lying on red sand. The camera is 'inside' a gallery, showing termites moving through carved-out wooden tunnels. In the background, the bright desert sun peeks through a crack in the bark, illuminating dust motes and wood fibers.
visual_logic.ground: A mix of chewed wood pulp ('frass') and fine red sand tracked in from outside.
visual_logic.lighting: Warm, diffused light filtering through the wood, giving the termites a gentle 'internal glow' due to their thin shells.
